fold_mask_proof.negative_selector_counterexample: For mask 0x001f and K4, a priority selector that fails to clear selected bits emits 0x000f twice, duplicates four sources and loses 0x0010.

k4_ratio_interpretation.paper_safe_wording: Exact frozen heldout service-island cycle DSE projects 3.173x versus the fixed8 service-token denominator and 1.251x incremental candidate-cycle speedup versus K1, before selector, four-read cache, adder-tree, frequency and physical normalization.

cache_capacity_ruling.ruling: The contract explicitly says per output block, so 1.5 KB is not a legal total-capacity claim. A design with all eight output blocks resident requires 12 KB before read-port realization. A 1.5 KB total design is possible only with one shared block-phased cache, explicit block lifetime/invalidation and a schedule proof; M122 does not provide that proof.

rmw_hazard_ruling.conclusion: M123 makes II=1 same-address accumulation plausible, but the 3.173x DSE is not admitted until a K4 fold-to-M123 integrated stream demonstrates selection, four weight reads, signed10 lane sums, forwarding and exact token conservation.

P1.title: Per-block cache entry can be misread as total capacity
P1.finding: 1.5 KB is 16 vectors for one output block. Eight simultaneously resident blocks require 12 KB; using 1.5 KB as the physical total undercounts storage by 8x.

P1.title: The 1.5 KB shared-cache alternative lacks a block-phase schedule
P1.finding: A single shared bank may avoid 8x residency, but block ordering, tags, invalidation, loads and transitions are not represented in the recurrence.

P1.title: Four logical vector reads have no realizable memory contract
P1.finding: K4 requires 3072 weight bits per fold cycle. Multiport macro, replication, banking, muxing, timing and energy are all outside the model.

P1.title: Selector and 96-lane K4 adder tree are assumed free within one cycle
P1.finding: The cycle DSE does not charge priority extraction, four 16-to-1 selections per lane, 192 signed9 adders, 96 signed10 adders, pipelining or reduced clock frequency.

P1.title: K4 is not integrated with the forwarding accumulator
P1.finding: M123 independently validates a same-address forwarding primitive, but no commercial VCS stream composes K4 selection/cache/fold with M123.

P1.title: K1 rtl_vcs=true is broader than the frozen evidence
P1.finding: M121 is a directed two-descriptor RTL run and explicitly says heldout replay and module-cycle projection are false. The M122 heldout K1 DSE itself is not RTL-measured.

P1.title: The 3.173x denominator inherits unmatched controller scope
P1.finding: The fixed8 denominator is exact service tokens plus shared commit/flush, but lacks a matched descriptor/controller ingress recurrence. It is not equal-controller end-to-end speedup.

P2.title: Canonical selector order is unspecified
P2.recommendation: Freeze select-and-clear order and prove mask remainder decreases on every accepted fold.

P2.title: Cache validity and block identity are unspecified
P2.recommendation: Define key/block tags, fill completion, invalidation and retry/reset behavior before RTL.

P2.title: Aggregate histogram hides burst pressure
P2.recommendation: Report per-descriptor and per-window maxima for K4 multi-update masks, cache reads and same-address chain lengths.

P2.title: K4 versus K8 choice lacks normalized physical Pareto data
P2.recommendation: Compare K2/K4/K8 after synthesis with the same cache realization and achieved clock, not logical read count alone.
